name: Defenestration
source:
Defenestration is a parody/satire/comedy RPG, set in a futuristic soviet union. The player takes up the role of Kira, a young promising girl fresh out of school. Help her get on her feet in unfamiliar megalopolis, dealing with various day-to-day problems and ridiculous characters. The game is choice based and has some open world elements.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/freshmulan]Patreon[/url]]
